You could try audiobooks if you aren't one for reading line after line of text. Or even comic books, if you're up for it.

But before that I recommend trying to find just one book that really captivates you. If you find one book that you really love, you are bound to find more that do the same for you. It's the same as music. To find your favorite musician you have to sift through a lot of crap, but it's worth it. Then you can find other artists that are similar to your favorite. You can expand from there.

If you want to write, you need to practice. Practice on subs like /v/writingprompts, and even try story telling with your friends.

You could always ask someone to write it for you. Give them the idea you want and work with them as they write it. Joint works are some of my favorite novels. I would also like to throw my hat into the ring. I sometimes write.
